run_fastcsp_full_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config file
run_fastcsp_specific_stages: run the FastCSP workflow with specific stages like generate and relax
run_fastcsp_with_config: run the FastCSP CLI with a config file and default workflow stages
review_cli_main: review the cli_main function that parses arguments for the FastCSP workflow
refactor_cli_main: refactor the cli_main function to add new workflow stage options
